note: Natural business questions, labelled wide: every reading a reasonable person asking those words would accept is listed. Slots are lists of acceptable names; order is never scored. contoso-pair items are asked on both copies (raw and prepared). Relative time is answered by a split on the period column where a person could read their answer off it. A top N appears only when a number is in the words. 'decline' means no reading can answer it.
